nodes.name: GET /login (keep-alive)
nodes.notes: Render's free tier spins the app down after ~15 min of no external traffic. Agent 4 (Gmail poll, every minute) and Agent 6 (cron, every 30 min) each carry their own Warm Up App + retryOnFail budget to ride out a cold start when they hit one, but that combined budget (~45-50s max) occasionally isn't enough on its own -- confirmed live (execution 892): a cold start took long enough that GET /sequences/due still 503'd even after its own node's retries AND the Warm Up App node's retries were both genuinely exhausted. Pinging the app every 10 minutes -- well under Render's 15-min idle window -- keeps it warm continuously, so the other agents rarely need their retry budgets to begin with. This ping's own result is irrelevant (neverError + no downstream node), so it has no failure mode of its own.
